name: google-calendar
description: Google Calendar workflows for agenda review, event search, free-busy checks, meeting prep, and review-gated scheduling actions.

interface.shortDescription: Read agendas, find events, check availability, and schedule with confirmation safeguards.
interface.longDescription: Google Calendar gives Gilbert Codex a dedicated plugin surface for schedule workflows with up to six connected Google accounts, agenda and event search, free-busy checks, meeting prep context, and review-gated create, update, and delete actions.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my Google Calendar agenda for today.
Find a free 30 minute window this week.
Create a draft calendar event and let me review it before adding it.
